compile.description: Compile main sources (fastest loop; 180s timeout to catch hangs)

build.description: Compile + run all unit and black-box e2e tests (300s: full suite incl. a cold daemon)

test.description: Run the full test suite (unit + black-box e2e; 300s to cover a cold daemon)

test_class.description: Run a single test class (or Class.method) via [args] (re-links installDist first; 180s timeout)

dependency_updates.description: Dependency update audit: stable-only candidates, report-only (not wired into check)

lint_scripts.command: bash -n bin/acp-agent bin/acp-agent-sandbox build-docker .ai/scripts/show-test-failures.sh && shellcheck bin/acp-agent bin/acp-agent-sandbox build-docker .ai/scripts/show-test-failures.sh
lint_scripts.description: Validate the wrapper, build and .ai helper scripts

show_failures.description: Print failure messages from the latest JUnit XML reports

sources.description: Resolve + unpack -sources jars of the main+test classpath into build/library-sources-unpacked/<artifact>/ for browsing library code at the exact resolved versions (180s timeout)

listLibs.description: Print resolved dependency trees with exact versions; pass --configuration runtimeClasspath or --configuration testRuntimeClasspath

git.description: Run arbitrary git commands (read-only inspection: status, diff, log, show ...)

compile_test.description: Compile test sources (fastest loop for test-code errors)

test_fresh.description: Run the full test suite with all task outputs discarded (--rerun-tasks), bypassing the build cache when a run looked suspiciously up-to-date

system_prompt.description: Print the assembled system prompt without AGENTS.md, rendered from invented example values so every section shows

spec_list.description: OpenSpec inventory (read-only). [args] examples: --specs --json (capabilities + requirement counts) | --json (open changes) | --all --json.

spec_status.description: OpenSpec artifact checklist for one change (read-only). [args]: change name; the output's nextSteps names the next command.

spec_instructions.description: OpenSpec instruction + template for the next artifact (read-only). [args]: <artifact> --change <name> --json, or apply --change <name> --json.

spec_validate.description: OpenSpec shape gate (read-only). [args]: --all --strict --json, or one change/spec name. Exit 1 = findings.

spec_new_change.description: MUTATING (creates openspec/changes/<name>/), build/bash only, never plan. [args]: <name> [--goal <text>]

spec_archive.description: MUTATING (merges deltas into specs/, moves the folder to changes/archive/), build/bash only, never plan. [args]: change name. -y is baked; validation runs first and refuses invalid deltas.
